I wrote up some of the details of me working through Riemann's Divergence theorem using Claude - https://rkirov.github.io/posts/lean6/.

Specifically, trying to balance still building mathematical intuition while Claude is already fully capable of autoformalizing these classic results and collaborating to make the final lean proof something I can stand by.

Disclaimer - I did use Claude to flesh out and edit the post, but also left the raw version at https://rkirov.github.io/posts/lean6-raw/ as a proof that this wasn't one-shotted blogslop (experimenting with new blog etiquettes in this AI gen world).
